versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g Definition of provided resource in the context of the Software Cluster Binary Manifest A provided resource of a Software Cluster Binary Manifest represents an “offer” of the Software Cluster to other Software Cluster s. For the formal point of view, this “offer” is defined by means of a BinaryMani- festProvideResource , aggregated at CpSoftwareClusterBinaryManifest- Descriptor in the role provideResource . Attribute supportsMultipleNotifierSets indicates whether the resource sup- port the call of multiple notifier call-back functions.
